name: net_lone_result_does_not_decide
description: A modified client claims the match won early while its partner plays on and keeps hashing: the partner's simulation runs past the claimed tick, so with two seats the match ends "desynced" at that tick, never "won" on one seat's word (design 6.1, 6.10).

steps.assert: scene.seq.outcome == 'desynced' and scene.seq.end_reason == 'desync' and scene.seq.final_tick == claimed
steps.msg: client 1 hashed past the claimed end: the referee ends the match desynced at the claimed tick
the honest client was present and hashing past the claim
the claim was taken (inside its limits), and still decided nothing alone
